name: the fantastic four
mana cost: {R}{G}{W}{U}
types: legendary creature human hero
power toughness: 4/4
triggered: when CARDNAME enter and whenever you cast a spell with power, toughness, or mana value 4, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn.
option[1]: create a 0/4 colorless wall creature token with defender.
option[2]: CARDNAME deal 3 damage to each opponent.
option[3]: put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.
option[4]: draw a card.
